source: 701 The Cheerful Franca
target: 701 Franca Laeta

source: In Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
target: In Quartiere Cathédralae Commemorativae, Habitaculum 702, 9 Via Orosai.

source: Franca, dressed in a camel-colored cashmere coat, shivered and said to Lumian, “As soon as I have the money, I’m definitely renting a villa with underfloor heating!”
target: Franca, induta pallio cashmere coloris camelus habente, tremuit et ad Lumian dixit: “Quo mox pecuniam habeam, certe vilam cum calefactione sub pavimento conducam!”

source: The concept of underfloor heating was proposed by Emperor Roselle.
target: Conceptus calefactionis sub pavimento a Imperatore Roselle propositus est.

source: By laying metal pipes in the house during construction, boiling water could flow through them, providing summer-like warmth in confined spaces and keeping out the cold weather.
target: Perponendo fistulas metallicas in domo tempore constructionis, aqua fervens per eas fluere poterat, praebens aestate similem calorem in spatiis arctis atque frigora repellens.

source: This was a must-have amenity for Trier’s current upscale residences.
target: Hoc erat munus necessarium pro residentibus opulentibus Trier.

source: “Why would a Demoness like you be afraid of the cold?” Lumian scoffed.
target: “Cur daemonissa ut tu frigore timere velis?” inquit Lumian irridens.

source: He glanced at Jenna and noticed she was wearing a black cotton dress and dark makeup, as if portraying a Witch or Vampire in the little details of her daily life.
target: Illum intuefactus ad Jennam, animadvertitque eam gerere vestem ex cotone nigro et ornata lineamentis obscuris, quasi in minutis vitae suae partibus magam aut vampyram depingere velle.

source: “I’m not a Pyromaniac. A Demoness’s black flames have no temperature!” Franca retorted with a smile.
target: “Non sum pyromaniaca. Flammae nigrae daemonissae nullam habent temperiem!” inquit Franca subridente.

source: Lumian casually settled onto the divan.
target: Lumian leviter in divano consedit.

source: “Aren’t Demonesses skilled with ice? Don’t they have resistance to frost and cold?”
target: Nonne daemonissae in glacie peritissimae sint? Nonne ad rigorem et frigorem resistent?

source: Franca reclined in her recliner, pulled up a cashmere blanket, and chuckled.
target: Franca in suo lecto reclinato, stragulum cashmere sublatum, atque risu excussit.

source: “I admit my performance just now was a little exaggerated, but Trier’s winters really are cold. It’s mainly because it’s so humid. It’s like being soaked in a semi-frozen lake.”
target: Admitto meum actuam nuper paulum exagitatum fuisse, sed hiemes Trier vere frigidae sunt.

source: After the small talk, Franca sighed and said, “I’ve already obtained more information about Moran Avigny and the corresponding security detail. We can put the capture plan on the agenda. And you, my friend, are about to participate in the Dream Festival. Talk about a scheduling conflict.”
target: Post sermones leves, Franca suspiravit et dixit: “Iam plura de Moran Avigny et de securitatis apparato cognovi. Consilium de captura in agenda ponere possumus. Et tu, amice, mox in Festival Somniorum participabis. Quam conflictum horarium!”

source: Lumian’s expression remained unchanged as he replied, “The Dream Festival is over.”
target: Figura Lumiani immota mansit, cum respondit: “Festival Somniorum peractum est.”

source: “Huh?” Franca and Jenna were taken aback.
target: “Heu?” Franca et Jenna obstupefactae erant.

source: Already?
target: Iam?

source: Lumian recounted everything that had transpired during the Dream Festival, including Madam Magician’s subsequent explanation.
target: Lumian omnia quae in Festival Somniorum facta erant recitavit, necnon explanationem subsequens a Domina Magica.

source: Of course, as the name Farbauti couldn’t be pronounced in any language, Lumian referred to it as the Devil Monarch and replaced Naboredisley with “the Demon with a long name.”
target: Certe, cum nomen Farbauti in quacumque lingua pronuntiari non posset, Lumian illud appellavit “Monarcha Diaboli” et Naboredisley substituit cum “daemonem nomine longo.”

source: Franca’s breathing quickened upon hearing that Lumian had donned a golden mask and spotted the suspected Underworld Daoist.
target: Francae respiratio celeravit, audito nuntio quod Lumian larvam auream induisset et suspectum Taoista Inferni conspexisset.

source: Lumian’s description of the Underworld Daoist’s attire made her eyes light up like sunlight dancing on a lake.
target: Descriptio Lumiani de habitu Taoista Inferni oculos eius fulgere fecit, velut radios solis in lacu saltantes.

source: Thankfully, her self-control was impressive.
target: Gratias Deo, eius continentia praeclara erat.

source: She endured until Lumian finished explaining the entire situation before asking anxiously, “Will there be another Dream Festival next year?”
target: Patienter sustinuit donec Lumian totam rem enarravit, et deinde sollicite rogavit: “Eruntne iterum Festival Somniorum proximo anno?”

source: “You want to participate in next year’s Dream Festival and come into direct contact with the Underworld Daoist?” Lumian could guess Franca’s thoughts.
target: “Visne proximo anno in Festival Somniorum participare atque directe cum Taoista Inferni contactum habere?” Lumian putavit Francae cogitationes.

source: Franca nodded emphatically.
target: Franca vehementer annuit.

source: “I believe that if the Underworld Daoist can bestow the Evernight pathway’s power on Amandina, I, uh, a Demoness, shouldn’t have any issues either. I wouldn’t mind taking Him as my master!”
target: “Credo, si Taoista Inferni potest viam Noctis Aeternae potentiam Amandinae tribuere, ego daemonissa quoque non difficultate laborabo; non mihi molestum erit eum magistro meo accipere!”

source: “Don’t worry. As long as I remain lucid, I won’t unleash my bestial instincts during the Dream Festival.”
target: “Noli solliciti esse. Dummodo mens mea lucida maneat, instinctus bestiales meos in Festival Somniorum non eruam.”

source: She teased herself.
target: Se iocose vexavit.

source: Originally, you wanted to say that you’re from the same homeland and not a Demoness, right?
target: Initio, volebāsne dicere te eadem patria esse et non daemonissa esse, nonne?

source: Lumian chuckled and said, “It’s not impossible, but you have to become an Angel first.”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Non est impossibile, sed necesse est ut primo angelus fias.”

source: “…” Franca fell silent.
target: “...” Franca tacuit.

source: Jenna pondered and said, “There’s something I don’t understand. Isn’t it the case that after obtaining the ability to stay lucid in the special dream, the corresponding dream projection will gradually dissipate? Why didn’t Hisoka’s?”
target: Jenna meditata est et dixit: “Aliquid mihi incertum est. Nonne, postquam facultatem lucidi somnii specialis obtinetur, eius proiectio somnii paulatim evanescit? Cur Hisoka non fecit hoc?”

source: Lumian had already considered this question.
target: Lumian hanc quaestionem iam cogitaverat.

source: “Perhaps this is one of the reasons Hisoka had to leave Tizamo.
target: “Forsitan haec est una ex causis quae Hisoka Tizamo relinquere coegit.

source: “The ability to stay lucid in the special dream shouldn’t be permanent. Once you leave Tizamo, it will gradually fade. Therefore, Hisoka not only had to leave Tizamo, but also had to return two to three times a year for at least a week each time to maintain the existence of the dream projection.”
target: “Facultas ut in somnio speciali lucida maneas non debet permanere. Quoniam Tizamo relinqueris, ea paulatim evanescet. Ita Hisoka non solum Tizamo relinquere debuit, sed etiam bis ad ter in anno, saltem per hebdomadam singulis vice, redire oportuit ut proiectionis somnii existentia servaretur.”

source: After discussing the Dream Festival, Franca briefly recounted the information she had obtained from 007 the previous night.
target: Postquam de Festival Somniorum dissererunt, Franca breviter recitavit informationes quas a 007 nocte praeterita adeptus erat.

source: “Moran Avigny’s family has a long history.
target: Familia Moran Avigny historiam longam habet.

source: Members span the military, political, artistic, and business worlds.
target: Membra eius in rebus militaribus, politicis, artisticis, et negotiis versantur.

source: Combined with the information Madam Judgment gave us, I suspect this is a branch of the Tamara family.
target: Coniuncta cum informationibus quas Domina Iudicium dedit, suspicor hanc esse ramum familiae Tamarae.

source: Their dark-gray eyes are one of the defining characteristics of the Tamara bloodline!
target: Oculi eorum fuscis et cinereis sunt, quae notae sunt definitoriae stirpis Tamarae!

source: Of course, not everyone with dark-gray eyes belongs to the Tamara family.
target: Certe, non omnes cum oculis fuscis et cinereis familiae Tamarae pertinent.

source: It’s more that members of the family are likely to have dark-gray eyes.
target: Potissimum, membris familiae verisimile est oculos fuscos et cinereos habere.

source: Based on the close connection between a large branch of the Tamara family and the Demoness Sect, it’s very likely that Demoness of Black Clarice also shares the Tamara family’s bloodline.
target: Ex intima nexu inter amplam partem familiae Tamarae et Sectam Daemonissarum, verisimile est Demonissam Nigram Claricem etiam stirpis Tamarae sanguinem communicare.

source: Following my hypothesis, the Demoness of Black might be a mixed-blood descendant of the Sauron family who pledged allegiance to the Demoness Sect and the Tamara family.”
target: Secundum hypothesim meam, Demonissa Nigrum fortasse sit descendentia mixti sanguinis ex familia Sauron, quae fidem Sectae Daemonissarum et familiae Tamarae dedit.

source: This was the only explanation for Demoness of Black Clarice’s reaction when she heard about the Sauron family.
target: Haec sola erat explanatio reactionis Demonissae Nigrae Clarice, cum de familia Sauron audiret.

source: It was also the only explanation for her indulging Browns Sauron!
target: Haec etiam sola erat explanatio indulgentiae eius erga “Browns Sauron”!

source: Lumian didn’t interrupt as Franca continued, “We need to face not only Moran Avigny but also the hidden Tamara family and the Mirror People faction.
target: Lumian non intermisit, dum Franca continuabat: “Non solum Moran Avigny, sed etiam familiam Tamara latentem atque factionem Hominum Specularum oppugnare debemus.

source: Moran Avigny might possess powerful Beyonder powers himself.
target: Moran Avigny ipse fortasse potentiam Beyonder praeclaram possidet.

source: Furthermore, Bureau 8, Purifiers, and Machinery Hivemind rotate daily, with a regular Beyonder team providing protection.
target: Praeterea, Bureau 8, Purificatores, et Machinae Hivemind quotidie variari solent, turma Beyonder ordinaria tutela praebens.

source: What my friend means is that if we’re unafraid of sacrifice, there’s still a chance of assassinating Moran Avigny. However, capturing him alive or channeling his spirit is very difficult and dangerous.”
target: Quod amicus meus significat est, si nullus timor sacrificii nos impedit, adhuc occasio existit ut Moran Avigny occidamus. Attamen, eum vivum capere aut spiritum eius canalizare valde difficile et periculosum est.

source: What 007 truly meant was that the Purifiers wouldn’t go easy on us or provide overt assistance.
target: Quod 007 vere intendebat, fuit quod Purificatores nobis non leniter se gerent nec auxilium apertum praebeant.

source: However, if Moran Avigny’s true nature as a Mirror Person is exposed after his death, 007 would find a way to allow us—the captured assassins—an opportunity to escape, just like when Jenna killed Hugues Artois.
target: Attamen, si vera natura Moran Avigny ut Homo Specularis post mortem revelatur, 007 viam inveniret ut nobis—captis sicariis—occasionem ad effugiendum daret, sicut cum Jenna Hugues Artois interemit.

source: However, if we didn’t want to obtain more information about the Mirror People through Moran Avigny, wouldn’t it be better to inform the authorities and let them handle the arrest?
target: Attamen, si plura de Hominibus Specularibus per Moran Avigny non cupimus adipisci, nonne melius esset auctoritatibus referre et eos de captu agere sinere?

source: Lumian pondered for a moment and said to Franca, “Let’s not rush into a plan. We’ll discuss it tomorrow.”
target: Lumian paulisper cogitavit et Francae dixit: “Nolimus consilium festinanter capere. Cras de eo disputabimus.”

source: “Why wait until tomorrow?” Franca asked, holding the stack of papers 007 had given her.
target: “Cur cras exspectare?” rogavit Franca, tenens fasciculum chartarum quas 007 ei dederat.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridens risit.

source: “After I find a safe place to complete my advancement and become a Fate Appropriator, perhaps a special, mixed ability related to fate will appear. That might help us obtain new ideas and come up with more effective solutions.”
target: “Postquam locum tutum inveni ad progressionem meam complendam et Fatum Appropriator fieri, fortasse specialis et mixtae naturae facultas, de fato pertinens, apparebit. Quod nos adiuvabit ad novas ideas obtinendas et solutiones efficaciores excogitandas.”

source: In the current four-person team, it was no secret that Lumian possessed the power of the Inevitability pathway.
target: In turma quatuor personarum, non erat ignotum quod Lumian potentiam itineris Inevitabilitatis haberet.

source: Franca blurted out in surprise, “You can obtain a new boon so quickly?”
target: Franca obstupita exclamavit: “Tam celeriter novum donum adipisci potes?”

source: “Didn’t I just mention it?” Lumian smiled. “I culled nearly 20 Sequence 6 and Sequence 5 bestowed in one go, significantly digesting the potion.”
target: “Non numquamne id dixeram?” subridens Lumian respondit: “Aggregavi fere viginti ‘Sequence 6’ atque ‘Sequence 5’ simul, potionem valde bene digerens.”

source: Franca pursed her lips and signaled to Lumian with her eyes: Look, look into my eyes! They’re filled with jealousy!
target: Franca labra contraxit et oculis Lumiano signavit: “Ecce, ecce intuere oculos meos! Iis plenis invidiae sunt!”

source: Lumian turned to Anthony and asked, “What did you mean by genuine identity?”
target: Lumian ad Anthonium conversus rogavit: “Quid per genuinam identitatem intellexisti?”

source: Anthony, who had been listening quietly and was on the verge of being forgotten, explained simply, “Actually, it was a hint from Madam Justice. That identity is very strange. His background, education, and experiences are all real, but there’s actually no such person. And the people who might expose this are either long dead or out of town, the kind who won’t return for years.”
target: Anthony, qui quiete auscultabat et iam fere oblivioni tradebatur, simpliciter explicavit: “Revera, id fuit insigne a Domina Iudicium. Illa identitas valde mirabilis est: eius originis, eruditionis, et experientiarum omnes verae sunt, sed re vera talis persona non existit. Et homines qui hoc revelare poterunt, vel iam diu mortui sunt vel extra urbem manent, neque per annos redire volunt.”

source: Franca made a judgment based on her experience. “It seems it was meticulously crafted years in advance as a disguise.”
target: Franca, ex experientia sua, iudicavit: “Videtur annos praevisa esse subtiliter compositum ut larva.”

source: Since they weren’t discussing a plan to deal with Moran Avigny today, Anthony didn’t stay long. He had to prepare for tonight’s banquet.
target: Cum hodie de consilio ad Moran Avigny agendum non disseretur, Anthonius non diutius mansit; praeparare cenam huius noctis debebat.

source: “Where do you plan to advance to Fate Appropriator?” Jenna asked Lumian. “The sacrificial square in the catacombs?”
target: “Quo locum intendis ad Fatum Appropriator ascendere?” rogavit Jenna Lumian. “Platea sacrificii in catacumbis?”

source: It belonged to two orthodox gods and could protect advancers from additional interference.
target: Illud duobus deorum orthodoxis pertinuit et progressores a perturbationibus ulterioribus tutari poterat.

source: “I’m afraid I’ll trigger a taboo and be purified by sunlight,” Lumian dismissed the suggestion with amusement.
target: “Timeo ne tabum incitet et luce solari purgabor,” inquit Lumian subridens.

source: “Advancing to Conspirer is different from advancing to Fate Appropriator.”
target: Ascendere ad Conspiratorem aliter est quam ad Fatum Appropriator progredi.

source: One belonged to the pathways of the divine, while the other belonged to an evil god’s domain!
target: Unus pertinebat ad semitas divinas, alter vero ad dominium dei mali!

source: Lumian had already decided on a location to advance.
target: Lumian iam locum progrediendi statuit.

source: It was the Nation of the Evernight!
target: Erat Natio Noctis Aeternae!

source: Termiboros’s well-behaved nature kept Lumian concerned that He was waiting for an opportunity to stir up trouble.
target: Comportatio modesta Termiboros Lumian curavit, ne ille occasionem tumultum excitandi exspectaret.

source: And as a Fate Appropriator began to involve core abilities in the Inevitability domain, it was very likely that Termiboros would tamper at this Sequence.
target: Et cum Fatum Appropriator virtutes nucleares in campo Inevitabilitatis implicare inciperet, verisimile erat Termiboros in hoc ordine immiscere.

source: Therefore, Lumian had to be cautious. He planned to advance in a safe place that could eliminate many external influences.
target: Itaque, Lumian cautus esse debebat. Cogitavit se in loco tuto progredi, qui multas influentias externas extruere posset.

source: Among them, the Nation of the Evernight was the best choice.
target: Inter ea, Natio Noctis Aeternae optima electio erat.

source: Furthermore, Lumian had planned to contact Hela in the next two days to share information about the Underworld Daoist and the Dream Festival.
target: Praeterea, Lumian conciliaverat ut Hela per proximos duas dies contactaret ad informationes de Taoista Inferni et Festival Somniorum communicandas.

source: Franca looked at Lumian in enlightenment. “You want to advance at our mysticism gathering?”
target: Franca, lumine in vultu, intuens Lumian, dixit: “Visne apud conventum mysticum nostrum progredi?”

source: “Yes.” Lumian nodded slightly.
target: “Ita,” respondit; Lumian leviter annuit.

source: Franca, who was in a good mood, took the initiative to help. “I’ll help you write the letter!”
target: Franca, bona mente afficta, inceptum tulit: “Adiuvabo te epistulam scribere!”

source: After she entered the bedroom and closed the door, Lumian looked at Jenna and said, “You’re very quiet today.”
target: Postquam in cubiculum ingressa et ianuam clausit, Lumian Jennam respexit et dixit: “Hodie valde tacita es.”

source: Jenna smiled. “An excellent theater actress must know how to act like a lady.”
target: Jenna subridens inquit: “Elegans actrix scaenica sciat ut quasi domina agat.”

source: Lumian glanced at Franca’s door.
target: Lumian Francae ianuam intuens.

source: “Madame Red Boots seems to be in high spirits today. She’s cracking jokes left and right.”
target: “Domina Red Boots hodie animose se habet; iocos huc atque illuc iacit.”

source: “It’s true she’s been in a good mood recently,” Jenna replied truthfully.
target: “Certe, nuper bonam animum habuit,” respondit Jenna veraciter.

source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully and didn’t probe further.
target: Lumian cogitans annuit et amplius non quaesivit.

source: Jenna’s lips curled into a smile. “Why don’t you keep asking?”
target: Labia Jenna in risu subacta sunt. “Cur non pergas quaerere?”

source: Lumian leaned back on the sofa and laughed self-deprecatingly.
target: Lumian in sofa recubuit et se ipsum humiliter subridens cachinnavit.

source: “My sister once taught me that there’s no need to inquire too deeply about certain matters. If I know too much, I might regret it. I might even have to face problems I’m unwilling to face.”
target: “Soror mea olim me docuit: non opus est nimis percontari de rebus, nam si nimis sciam, paenitem, atque fortasse difficultates subire debeam quas nolo subire.”

source: Jenna listened attentively, placed her hand on her cheek, and asked with a smile, “What are you afraid of?”
target: Jenna attente auscultavit, manum in maxillam posuit, et subridens rogavit: “Quid times?”

source: Lumian strategically took a sip of black tea and said, “It’s not fear; it’s respect.”
target: Lumian callide sorbetum theae nigrae bibit, et dixit: “Non timor est; reverentia est.”

source: Jenna gazed at him and suddenly laughed.
target: Jenna eum intuens subito risit.

source: She didn’t press further and chatted with Lumian about the details of Tizamo.
target: Ea non pergere insitit et cum Lumiano de singularibus Tizamo disseruit.

source: Before long, Franca opened the door and exclaimed with a smile, “It’s on for tonight!”
target: Mox Franca ianuam aperuit et subridens exclamavit: “Hodie nocte incipit!”

source: At 10 p.m., in the ancient and dilapidated palace of the Nation of the Evernight, Lumian and Franca swiftly materialized, and Hela was already waiting.
target: Ad horam decimam post meridiem, in antiquo et ruinoso palatio Nationis Noctis Aeternae, Lumian et Franca celeriter apparuerunt, et Hela iam exspectabat.
